name: dftracer_session
description: Create and manage a dftracer session workspace: clone or import an app (session_create, session_import_local_tree), build the canonical baseline/annotated/opt<n> layout, read/write/edit/remove files inside it, run paths, runs, structure validation and reorganization, status and system info; validator dftracer_session_check.
